text:
maya: Heads up — noticed 8 nodes in the scratchpool hit SMART media_wear thresholds and started the retire path. GPU provisioning is failing for some smaller batch jobs :warning:
ops-bot: alert: scratchpool-retire triggered on nodes: gnode-0734, gnode-0737, gnode-0741 — marked DRAINING
liam: Which region is this hitting? Any customer impact yet?
maya: Mostly eu-west2. Started after the spot swap last night. IOPS profile shows large concurrent write bursts from nightly /scratch GC tasks, then short read storms.
noah: Quick log excerpt from gnode-0734:
```
[2026-03-20T02:14:03Z] nvme0: qdepth=128 r/w=4800/1200 iops=125k io_wait=238ms
[2026-03-20T02:14:05Z] nvme0 SMART: media_wear_threshold=0x1BA WARN
[2026-03-20T02:14:07Z] kernel: blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 12345678
```
sophia: Can we pause janitor runs for that pool and throttle background GC? Seems like reclaim is exacerbating wear during the swap. :thinking_face:
maya: Plan: reduce janitor concurrency to 2 for scratchpool, move heavy trim/compact jobs to 04:00-06:00 window, and set an emergency `pool-retire-delay=12h` so drains batch instead of immediate. Should buy time for replacements.
julian: What's the mitigation for GPU provisioning? Customers are seeing job queue growth.
maya: Short-term: route new GPU provisioning requests away from eu-west2 to us-west1 and our Dedicated reserves. We'll failover non-critical pools. Ops cost: estimate ~ $18k for replacement NVMe parts + 2 days ops. Long-term: raise endurance spec for scratchpool parts.
liam: We should notify SRE oncall and Sales about potential latency blips and a small provisioning window. Also update the runbook with the emergency retire knob.
ops-bot: scheduled action: set janitor-concurrency=scratchpool:2 at 1719901490
janitor-bot: action taken — active cleans reduced from 8 -> 2; expected slower space reclaim, monitor occupancy metrics :spinner:
noah: Kicking off a canary drain of gnode-0734 now: `bin/drain-node gnode-0734 --canary`
maya: Thanks. Monitor `gpu-queue-length` and `scratch-iowait`. If iowait doesn't drop within 10m, escalate to full pool-shift. I'll post a status update in 30m. :heavy_check_mark:
